revisions: Recognize singular audiovisual detail routes with explicit audiovisual title markers without requiring an extracted media URL.
Recognize strong browse/search evidence from ItemList structure and multilingual filter, advanced-search and pagination text.
Remove research as a generic search-token heuristic because research pages may be informational rather than search interfaces.
Preserve direct audiovisual-object evidence with sufficient item specificity before ItemList/list inference.
Expand blocked AJAX filter semantics with generic theme/format keyword tokens while keeping access state separate.
Add optional per-entity review caps to support balanced future independent samples.

val_005_36_units_reused_after_validation.interpretation: These values are development diagnostics on data that informed protocol 2.2.0. They are not independent performance estimates.

unresolved_development_conflicts.description: Several technically near-identical detail pages share _doc/page parameters, oEmbed media, descriptions and comparable route structure but received different human D/G labels. Protocol 2.2.0 does not encode IDs or slugs to force agreement.
Magazine pages with embedded media include both human item_record and news_or_editorial labels; media presence alone is therefore not allowed to override editorial context.

scientific_decision: Accept protocol 2.2.0 only as a calibrated development candidate. Require a new preregistered, balanced, prediction-frozen independent ecological validation on entirely unseen corpora before any M4 scaling.
limitations: All 86 human-labelled URLs are now known development data for protocol 2.2.0.
The improved VAL-005 binary diagnostic is post-validation reuse and cannot be reported as generalisation performance.
Cineam contains structurally similar surfaces with conflicting human labels that cannot be resolved honestly by deterministic URL rules alone.
CICLIC exposes a semantic item-versus-editorial boundary that requires stronger content-role evidence than media presence.
The next independent validation must exclude all 86 known URLs and use corpora not previously observed for M3 development.
prohibited_interpretations: does not establish independent accuracy, precision, recall or F1 for protocol 2.2.0
does not modify the official T2 baseline
